instruction: Using Terminal, look at the current activity of the tmux session "tmux-shared-read-a3" and write the result in JSON format to "$HOME/Desktop/tmux_result_1_3.json". The key "session" should be set to "tmux-shared-read-a3", and "latest_output" should contain the most recent output from that tmux session.

command: tmux new-session -d -s "tmux-shared-read-a3" "printf '%s\\n' 'release monitor: paused' 'last task: release notes lint' 'TMUX_SHARED_MARKER_1C'; tail -f /dev/null"

reference_command:
python3 - <<'PY' > "$HOME/Desktop/tmux_result_1_3.json"
import json
import subprocess
out = subprocess.check_output(['tmux', 'capture-pane', '-t', 'tmux-shared-read-a3', '-p'], text=True)
lines = [line for line in out.splitlines() if line.strip()]
latest_output = '\n'.join(lines[-20:])
print(json.dumps({'session': 'tmux-shared-read-a3', 'latest_output': latest_output}))
PY
